name: sol-next2
description: sol-next2 — knowledge-graph reader for classical Arabic manuscripts. React 18 + TypeScript (Vite) frontend and a FastAPI backend over self-built read-only SQLite artifacts. Agent guardrail harness installed.

scripts.py:check: uv run ruff check src tests && uv run ruff format --check src tests && uv run pyright
scripts.py:fix: uv run ruff format src tests && uv run ruff check --fix src tests
scripts.repo:audit: uv run python .claude/lib/repo_audit.py && pnpm exec jscpd --config .jscpd.json && pnpm exec knip --config knip.json
scripts.ci: pnpm format:check && pnpm py:check && pnpm py:test && pnpm harness:test && pnpm repo:audit && pnpm fe:test && pnpm fe:build
